text:
alex: FYI PR #4824 adding new namespace `data-exporter` + service account with IRSA annotation. Can infra take a quick look?
priya: taking a look now. Is this intended for prod or staging? name is just `data-exporter`.
alex: prod workload (export jobs). we debated -prod vs bare name. open to guidance.
ben: tiny preference for `data-exporter-prod` to avoid collisions. also watch for terraform state naming.
alex: ok i'll change to -prod if that’s the consensus.
infra-bot: CI: terraform apply failed in step 'k8s:apply' — `error: serviceaccount "data-exporter-sa" not found in namespace "data-exporter"` (preview env pr-4824)
sam: that usually means the helm chart expects the SA to exist beforehand. in tf we create `kubernetes_namespace` then `kubernetes_manifest` for `ServiceAccount`. Are there any `depends_on` between them?
alex: right now we create ns and sa in same plan via `kubernetes_manifest`. no explicit depends_on.
sam: add `depends_on = [kubernetes_namespace.ns]` on the serviceaccount resource or ensure ordering in the pipeline. also for IRSA make sure `automountServiceAccountToken: true` is set so projected token is available.
omar: for annotation we need `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: ${aws_iam_role.irsa.arn}`. do NOT include `role_session_name` via annotation. role policy should allow `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity`.
priya: checked the role policy in TF module — has AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity, and the trust relationship maps to the OIDC provider. policy permissions look fine but KMS access for secret sync might be missing. the secret sync job uses KMS key `alias/redwood-secret` — need kms:Encrypt/Decrypt in role.
ben: +1 on KMS perms. also provider version: we had a bug with projected SA token unless `provider.kubernetes` >= 2.10.0. bump if needed.
alex: noted. i'll bump provider and add KMS perms.
ben: also confirm namespace naming change; if you change to `data-exporter-prod` ensure RBAC RoleBindings and ClusterRoleBindings updated.
alex: will update rolebinding names in the helm values.
infra-bot: preview deployed for pr-4824 after update: `/kubectl -n data-exporter get sa` returns 404, `/kubectl -n data-exporter-prod get sa` returns `data-exporter-sa` (created).
priya: sounds like the -prod name fix worked for preview. please still add depends_on to avoid race in prod.
sam: i recommend adding a small terratest or a pre-flight check in the pipeline that ensures namespace exists before helm install to avoid flaky apply.
alex: adding terratest check and `depends_on`. also setting `automountServiceAccountToken: true` in the manifest.
alex: code snippet i'm pushing in PR (terraform k8s manifest):
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_manifest" "data_exporter_sa" {
  manifest = {
    apiVersion = "v1"
    kind       = "ServiceAccount"
    metadata = {
      name      = "data-exporter-sa"
      namespace = kubernetes_namespace.data_exporter.metadata[0].name
      annotations = {
        "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = aws_iam_role.irsa.arn
      }
    }
    automountServiceAccountToken = true
  }
  depends_on = [kubernetes_namespace.data_exporter]
}
```
ben: looks good. once you bump provider and add KMS perms I can approve.
alex: bumped provider to 2.12.0, added KMS encrypt/decrypt to role, changed namespace to `data-exporter-prod`, added depends_on, and pushed. CI green.
ben: LGTM :thumbsup: approving PR.
priya: one more ask — add a note in the infra runbook about the serviceaccount -> role mapping and the KMS requirement so future changes don't miss it.
alex: adding runbook entry now. scheduling canary deploy tomorrow 01:00 PST. tagging @eng-sre for a quick watch.
infra-bot: deployed canary preview for pr-4824. `/kubectl -n data-exporter-prod logs -l app=data-exporter` shows initial cron job success.
ben: approved merge, go ahead :shipit:
alex: merging and kicking off prod apply. will post a follow-up in #incidents if anything unusual.
sam: i'll add the terratest in a follow-up PR and a pipeline gate to check namespace exists.
alex: thanks everyone — closing thread after post-deploy verification.
